target_customer: State and local governments and utilities (broadband offices), later AI infrastructure customers per the YC description
problem: Public agencies lacked software to run broadband and utility programs. The current YC description now says Ready builds AI-ready enclosures.
business_model: Government vertical SaaS (historical); hardware enclosures per current YC description
product_category: Govtech infrastructure software, now hardware and telecom

founders.name: Jase Wilson
founders.background_notes: One profile says he lost control of Neighborly and moved to Ready.net in 2019; that profile is promotional and unreliable.

founders.name: Mike Faloon
founders.background_notes: YC says capital markets veteran and former COO of a 150 billion dollar asset manager.

technical_complexity.rationale: Government workflow software with mapping data is standard engineering; hardware enclosures would raise complexity but are not documented for 2020.

defensibility.rationale: Government contracts and compliance-heavy workflows are sticky once adopted, but win rates depend on procurement.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying it.

market_need_then: Not sourced for 2020. Later coverage ties demand to the 42 billion dollar federal BEAD broadband program, which postdates founding.

branding.domain_note: ready.net per its site; a .net domain rather than .com.

brand_strength.rationale: A very generic English word is hard to search and no brand press was found.

pivots.why: Not stated in any source found; may reflect a YC profile rewrite.

outcome_analysis: Ready is Active with about 75 staff. A third-party profile reports a 10.5 million dollar Series A in October 2022 and its own pages describe broadband grant software for state offices, but the YC page now describes AI-ready enclosures. Primary funding evidence is missing and the direction change is unexplained, so the record carries low confidence.
notes: Unverified: Series A 10.5M Oct 2022 (Arbor, Caffeinated, Thiel Capital, Sprint VC) seen only on a single aggregator profile and Crunchbase-type snippet; total raised 16M (village.ai) or 14.63M conflict. Not recorded as a round. The AI enclosures description conflicts with the broadband software description; the identity of the company may have shifted and could not be confirmed. A 12M March 2020 Series A for a company named Ready is likely a different company. No dated competitor sources. Website not fetched.
